label: issue
evidence: repo regex `[^/.]+/[^/.]+` truncated `org/repo.js` → `org/repo`, breaking gh API for any repo with `.` in name
remediation: regex `[^/[:space:]]+/[^/[:space:]]+$` + post-strip optional `.git` suffix + defensive REPO shape validation

label: issue
evidence: any `gh api` failure (rate-limit / 5xx / network blip / expired auth) → empty RAW → blocks every push; GitHub incident → no one can push
remediation: distinguish gh-exit-non-zero (API unreachable → warn-pass with explanatory stderr) from gh-exit-zero-with-empty-body (real anomaly → block); stderr captured separately to a tmpfile

label: issue
evidence: jq missing → silent pass (no precondition check; same pattern in tdd-guard.sh)
remediation: explicit `command -v jq` precondition + BLOCKED message + exit 2

label: issue
evidence: push regex over-matched `git push --dry-run` and under-handled `git push -d` / `git push origin :foo` colon-prefix delete
remediation: explicit pass-through cases for `--dry-run` / `-d` / `--delete` / colon-prefix refspec

label: issue
evidence: PRIOR_MSG / HEAD_MSG echoed verbatim → terminal escape sequences in commit subjects render in user's terminal
remediation: wrap in `printf '%q'` for both BLOCKED message bodies

label: issue

remediation: setsid-spawn vitest into its own process group; timeout cleanup uses kill -TERM -- -PGID then kill -KILL -- -PGID

label: issue

label: issue

remediation: convert all 21 fixtures to use ShellSpec's `Data:expand` block; all hook fixtures previously gave false signals
